sourceAndScope.aggregate: actual nominal value/component category, pinned marker origin, declaration/name/member ranges, full field layout, permissions, implicit ctor and coverage. noInheritance true; no cycles; ! field requires null initializer, initialized field forbids !; private/protected retained in declaration but read requires actual supported public permission. category=value retains value semantics and category=component retains reference identity semantics; neither is a physical layout/GC proof.
sourceAndScope.captures: full original BindingId, original lexical ancestor and exact read/write pair; current finite capability only initialized enclosing unknown catch binding reads, no writes or runtime target/environment guesses.
sourceAndScope.completion: HIR retains high-level region and current-expression structure, with no inferred executable CFG or cached canComplete flags. Later Core lowering must compute explicit normal/abrupt completions; no success from erased try or revived never paths.
sourceAndScope.declarations: root parameters and direct body declarations only. Parameters are owned by function envelope, and a catch header binding is owned by Catch.range/declarationRange even though its name precedes the catch block Region.range. All other local declarations are contained in their region envelope. Nested child functions do not contribute locals to parent scopes. Lexical TDZ/hoisting and initialization order are inherited from the strict validated snapshot and independently reconstructed, never inferred from spelling.
sourceAndScope.flow: Binding.type is declared type; bindingRead.type is current occurrence type, including bool proof for declared unknown. Writes discard proof by original BindingId. No declaration-type substitution for current RHS; no never-path union revival.
sourceAndScope.modules: actual imports/exports, complete sources/root closure and one defining source per function. imports point to exported actual function target; signature evidence remains bound to target source. Global storage, hosts and combined aggregate/module or closure/module variants remain finite capability refusals.
sourceAndScope.ranges: original UTF16 half-open, no trimming/normalization at HIR projection. Keep all raw and trimmed variants exactly as validated. function root envelope=fn.range; module root envelope=[0,source.length). Empty root range permitted only for an actually empty module source.
sourceAndScope.scopeParent: root function parentScope=null; its declaringScope is module root or the actual parent-function declaration region. Nonroot region parentScope is enclosing region scope. Module implicit root scope exists even when initialization=null; when present its root region uses that same scope.
sourceAndScope.scopePath: root=[]; each nested region appends {statement:i,slot:role}, where i is its zero-based containing body index. if braced thenBody/elseBody wrapper block maps directly to then/else region, retaining that exact block range. Standalone block uses block; try blocks use try/catch/finally.
sourceAndScope.source: every operation range uses its enclosing function/module source, never the generated HIR text. Definitions/evidence retain the actual defining source; module call ranges are in caller source while signature evidence ranges belong to callee source.
sourceAndScope.target: Hir.target is an independently owned exact copy of the verified snapshot.target, including null. A null target stays null; do not infer, synthesize, default or borrow a platform from profile, source, another snapshot or any other context. Scalar-v2 cases04/06/09 require null-target coverage; integer first retains its original object target.
